acceptance: A CLEAN PR that passes every pr-arm gate merges through make pr-arm at the checked head; a unit test covers the clean-state path.
context: Revalidated 2026-11-11: still required and accurate. On origin/develop (c7b75c80bc) scripts/pr_arm.py (lines ~428-441) always runs `gh pr merge <n> --squash --auto --match-head-commit <head>` and treats a non-zero exit as `refused`; there is no branch for a PR whose mergeStateStatus is already CLEAN. Repo settings unchanged: allow_auto_merge is true and the develop ruleset (develop-squash-only, id 15611785) allows squash only with no merge queue, so a direct `gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit` after the same gates is accepted by GitHub. docs/agent/merge-authority.md is the place to state the clean-PR path. Open PR #4120 edits pr_arm.py (placeholder-refresh waiting) but does not add this path; implement after it merges.
description: On #3734, make pr-arm passed every gate but could not enable auto-merge because GitHub reported the PR already CLEAN (auto-merge cannot be enabled on a PR that is mergeable now). The closer fell back to a raw `gh pr merge --match-head-commit`, which the merge-authority rules forbid. pr-arm should handle this state itself, for example by merging with --match-head-commit after the same gates pass.
